name: Shrimp, Corn & Coconut Milk Chowder with Bell Pepper

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl, cover with water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash potatoes and bell peppers. Peel and medium dice potatoes. Seed and medium dice peppers. Remove husks and silks from corn. Stand up in the middle of a large bowl and slice kernels off the cob. Transfer everything to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 red bell peppers
6 ears corn

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic, potatoes, bell pepper, and corn to saucepan. Stir to combine.
Add coconut milk, broth, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (398 ml) can coconut milk
708 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp coriander
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain shrimp and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to saucepan while the chowder is cooking.
To serve, pour soup into a bowl and enjoy with bread on the side!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
